current.text: He is projected to come off the bench. The projected Golden State starters are Curry, Podziemski, Lendeborg, Green and Horford.
He might still start. Golden State may treat this as a gap year and rest veterans, and those rest days should give him enough minutes.
He competes with Yaxel Lendeborg for the same starting role. The more Draymond Green plays center, the more minutes open up for both.
Golden State's depth is very poor. They struggle to field a 10-man rotation, so minutes should go up across the rotation.
Steve Kerr often names a starting lineup and changes it a few games later. Expect a lot of mixing among the wings.
Jimmy Butler is out for at least half the season.
Butler's return will shake up the wing rotation again.
After last season's trade deadline he ranked 72nd. He played 31 minutes a game and averaged 15 points, 6 rebounds, 4 assists and 1.5 steals.
Some of his shooting last season was fluky.
He is worth a late flyer pick in rounds 11 to 13. With Porzingis out, his usage could go above 20, and he could be top 70 after the trade deadline.
The experts suggest drafting him together with Lendeborg as a hedge and keeping whichever one wins the role.
Josh still prefers Podziemski and Lendeborg to Santos.
Golden State has 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most in the league.
Golden State's schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end on March 28.

durable.text: He can create his own shot, which almost nobody else on Golden State besides Curry can do. He also has size.
He scored big when Curry was out last season but did much less when he played next to him.

note: He sits right at the edge of our 144-player pool: Yahoo ranks him 141, ESPN 248, and both sites value him at 0 USD. He is a 1 USD last-round flyer at most, and he works best paired with Lendeborg as a hedge for the same role. His projections have no weak category but also no real strength. In the first weeks, check who starts on the wing, whether he plays 25 minutes or more, and how often Green plays center. If someone else drafts him, watch him on waivers, since his post-deadline line last season (31 minutes, rank 72) shows his upside when he gets the role.
